description: This file contains React components implementing the marketing interface for DocumentHub, including navigation, hero section, stats, and footer, with external icon and UI component references.

methods.name: MarketingNav
methods.description: Renders the top navigation bar for the marketing landing page, including logo and navigation links.

methods.name: NavLink
methods.description: A helper component that renders a navigation link with animated underline on hover.

methods.name: MarketingHero
methods.description: Renders the hero section of the landing page with headline, description, call-to-action buttons, and stats.

methods.name: Stat
methods.description: Displays a statistic with icon, label, and value, used within the hero section.

methods.name: MarketingFooter
methods.description: Renders a simple footer for the marketing pages, including branding and links.
